hooks.command: repo_root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd); if [ -f "$repo_root/graphify-out/graph.json" ]; then printf '%s\n' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"allow","permissionDecisionReason":"graphify graph exists; use graphify-out/GRAPH_REPORT.md before raw search when relevant."}}'; else printf '%s\n' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"allow","permissionDecisionReason":"graphify graph missing; continue without graph guidance."}}'; fi
